title: The Feather Glued onto a Hat
youtube_title: The Feather Glued onto a Hat | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Telling the truth early makes a small mistake easier to mend.
summary: At a ceramic studio sill above the quiet plaza, Yuri is tangled up with a feather glued onto a hat that was only meant to be pinned and almost hides it. Yuri tells Grandpa Sol the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
